SELECT month, comm_sxt, yield_sxt, comm_sxt  * (SELECT price_usd FROM sxt.price_history ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS comm_usd, yield_sxt * (SELECT price_usd FROM sxt.price_history ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS yield_usd FROM sxt.v_validator_monthly WHERE validator_name = '${validator}' ORDER BY month  -- depends on ${earnings_view}
SELECT toString(era) AS era, argMax(total_stake, timestamp) AS total_stake FROM sxt.delegation_snapshots WHERE validator_name = '${validator}' GROUP BY era ORDER BY era
